besluite.fout: The block opens with 'Hy' straight after a block whose last subjects are the government (referred to as 'Sy plan') and the groups; Mandela is not named anywhere in that block.
besluite.rede: Naming Mandela at the start of the block removes a first-reading stumble over who 'Hy' is, without changing the claim or touching a protected word.

besluite.fout: 'met protes gehelp' is wooden, and 'met protes' is also a fixed expression for 'under protest', so the phrase can be misread as 'helped reluctantly'.
besluite.rede: 'met proteste gehelp' is the natural countable form and removes the misreading while saying the same thing.
'n Ander hofsaak' (a different case) is natural Afrikaans and accurate here; switching the determiner to 'nog 'n' changes the nuance to 'one more' without a fault to fix.

besluite.fout: In the [begrip] definition 'saamstem' (share an opinion) is imprecise for the outcome of negotiating, which is reaching an agreement; it also sits close to the protected 'saam stem' (vote together) in the lesson, which a Grade 4 reader may confuse.
besluite.rede: The point is real, but it rewords a glossary definition, which only the writer may change.
